definition_zh: 点头示意（现多用于 at someone's beck and call）；（英北方言）小溪
definition_en: a nod or gesture of command, surviving in the phrase at someone's beck and call; in northern English dialect, a small stream
core_image: 主人一个点头，仆人立刻应声而来
scene: 老宅的管家总是随叫随到，仿佛听命于一根手指的示意。The staff were at his beck and call from morning until night.
sceneCN: 这里 beck 是「点头示意」（第 1 个义项：表示召唤的点头或手势）；句意是仆人们从早到晚听候他随时的召唤。

pos.zh: 点头示意；召唤；（方言）小溪

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「招手；召唤」
由 beckon 加 -ing 构成，义为「召唤般的；吸引人的」

senses.title: A nod or gesture of command
senses.definition: a silent signal, especially a nod, used to summon someone
senses.definitionCN: 无声的信号，尤指点头，用来召唤他人
senses.example: The staff were at his beck and call from morning until night.
senses.exampleCN: 仆人们从早到晚听候他随时的召唤。
senses.why: The word is a shortened form of beckon, the act of bidding with a nod.
senses.whyCN: 该词是 beckon 的缩短形式，即以点头示意召人。

senses.title: A small stream in northern dialect
senses.definition: in northern English dialect, a small brook or stream
senses.definitionCN: 英格兰北方方言中的小河、溪流
senses.example: Sheep grazed beside the clear beck below the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 羊群在山下清澈的小溪旁吃草。
senses.why: This is a separate Old Norse word bikki for a stream, unrelated to beckoning.
senses.whyCN: 这是另一个源自古诺斯语 bikki（溪流）的词，与「召唤」义无关。

intro.en: Beck has two sources: a clipped beckon and a Norse word for a stream.
intro.cn: beck 有两个来源：beckon 的缩短形式，以及古诺斯语中表示溪流的词。

items.en: becnian meant to make a sign, source of beckon.
items.cn: 古英语 becnian 意为「做示意动作」，是 beckon 的来源。

items.en: beck arose as a shortened form of beknen.
items.cn: 中古英语 beck 由 beknen 缩短而来。

items.en: bikki meant a brook, giving the northern beck.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 bikki 意为小溪，衍生北方方言的 beck。

items.en: the phrase at beck and call fixed the summoning sense.
items.cn: 十四至十五世纪短语 at beck and call 固定了「召唤」义。

items.en: beck survives mainly in at someone's beck and call and in place names.
items.cn: 如今 beck 主要存于 at someone's beck and call 及地名中。

note.en: The look-alike group shares spelling or the beckon root; the near-meaning group gathers signals of command and small streams.
note.cn: 形近组共享拼写或 beckon 词根；近义组汇集指令信号与小溪。

entries.definition: to signal with a hand or nod to come
entries.definitionCN: 招手；点头召唤——beck 的完整形式
啄；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: the body part joining head and shoulders
entries.definitionCN: 颈；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a movement expressing an idea or command
entries.definitionCN: 手势；泛指表达意思的动作

normalIntro.en: Beck is beckon cut short, plus a Norse stream.
normalIntro.cn: beck 是 beckon 的缩短形式，另有古诺斯语「小溪」一源。

normal.en: At someone's beck and call means always ready to serve.
normal.cn: at someone's beck and call 意为听候随时差遣。

normal.en: In Yorkshire a beck is a stream.
The summoning sense needs a silent nod, not a word.
normal.cn: 「召唤」义靠无声点头，不需言语。

abstract.en: See a finger crooked once, and a servant appear.
abstract.cn: 看一根手指一勾，仆人便现身。

abstract.en: Hear the hush of a house waiting on a nod.
abstract.cn: 听一座宅邸等候点头的寂静。

abstract.en: Picture clear water sliding over stones.

examples.en: The staff were at his beck and call from morning until night.
examples.cn: 仆人们从早到晚听候他随时的召唤。

examples.en: Sheep grazed beside the clear beck below the hill.
examples.cn: 羊群在山下清澈的小溪旁吃草。

examples.en: A slight beck from the chairman ended the debate.
examples.cn: 主席轻轻一点头，辩论便告结束。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 beckon 丢了尾巴剩 beck」——把招手叫人剪短，就是「示意召唤」。

root: 「召唤」义源自古英语 becnian（做示意动作）的中古英语缩短形式 beck；「小溪」义则为另一个来源，即古诺斯语 bikki（溪流），两词同形异源；固定短语 at someone's beck and call 约定型于中古英语晚期。

sensesIntro.en: One clipped word serves the silent summons and, by separate roots, the northern stream.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个截短词，既指无声的召唤，又因另源而指北方的小溪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single nod that brings a servant running.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个点头便召来仆人。

branches.en: the clear beck below the hill

intro.en: Beck belongs to the becnian family that also gives beckon.
intro.cn: beck 属于 becnian 词族，同族还有 beckon。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the roots are Old English and Old Norse.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根为古英语与古诺斯语。

items.structure: Old English becnian via Middle English

derivatives.zh: 由同源完整形式构成，义为「招手；召唤」
由 beckon 加 -er 构成，义为「招手召唤者」
